tools.name: wheniwork_get_account
tools.description: Fetch the When I Work account (workplace) the token acts on — company name, plan and settings; for a parent account also its child accounts. A cheap way to confirm the credentials work. When I Work: GET /2/account.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_users
tools.description: List the employees, supervisors, managers and admins in the account, optionally limited to some schedules or searched by name/email. Role codes: 1 admin, 2 manager, 3 employee, 5 supervisor. When I Work: GET /2/users.

tools.name: wheniwork_get_user
tools.description: Fetch one user by id — name, email, role, positions, schedules, wage. When I Work: GET /2/users/{id}.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_locations
tools.description: List the schedules in the account. The API calls a schedule a "location"; its id is the location_id every shift belongs to. When I Work: GET /2/locations.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_positions
tools.description: List the positions (job roles such as Cashier or Dishwasher) in the account. When I Work: GET /2/positions.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_shifts
tools.description: List scheduled shifts in a time window — who works when, where and in which position — optionally including open shifts and unpublished drafts. Answers "who is on on Friday?" and "what open shifts are left?". When I Work: GET /2/shifts.

tools.name: wheniwork_get_shift
tools.description: Fetch one shift by id, including its breaks and publish state. When I Work: GET /2/shifts/{id}.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_eligible_users_for_shift
tools.description: Find who could take an open shift — either an existing shift (shift_id) or a hypothetical one (start, end, position_id and location_id all required). When I Work: GET /2/shifts/eligible.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_times
tools.description: List clocked time entries — actual hours worked, clock-in/out times, length and approval state. Use only_open to see who is clocked in right now. When I Work: GET /2/times.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_time_off_requests
tools.description: List time-off requests in a date range, with the requesting users. Status: 0 pending, 1 canceled, 2 accepted, 3 expired, 4 denied. When I Work: GET /2/requests.

tools.name: wheniwork_get_time_off_request
tools.description: Fetch one time-off request by id, with its message thread and users. When I Work: GET /2/requests/{request_id}.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_time_off_types
tools.description: List the time-off types (e.g. Personal, Sick, Holiday) and whether each allows paid time. Their ids are the type_id for a new request. When I Work: GET /2/requesttypes.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_shift_swaps
tools.description: List shift requests: swaps, drops and alerts, with the shifts and users involved. Status: 0 pending, 1 approved, 2 declined, 3 completed, 4 canceled, 5 expired. Type: 1 swap, 2 drop, 3 alert. start and end must be given together. When I Work: GET /2/swaps.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_availability
tools.description: List availability events — when people said they can or cannot work, including recurring patterns that fall in the window. Defaults to the caller, from now to two weeks out. When I Work: GET /2/availabilityevents.

tools.name: wheniwork_list_annotations
tools.description: List schedule annotations — announcements, business-closed days and blackout dates when time off is not allowed. Defaults to today through one year out. When I Work: GET /2/annotations.

tools.name: wheniwork_create_shift
tools.description: Create one shift on a schedule — assigned to a user, or open (user_id 0). Created as a draft unless published is true. Undo by editing it or unpublishing. When I Work: POST /2/shifts.

tools.name: wheniwork_update_shift
tools.description: Change a shift — reassign it, move it, change position or notes. When I Work requires start_time, end_time and location_id on every update, so fetch the shift first and pass them back. This tool never sends a breaks array; When I Work documents that breaks omitted from an update's breaks list are re

tools.name: wheniwork_publish_shifts
tools.description: Publish draft shifts so employees can see them. Publishing does not itself send notifications. Undo with wheniwork_unpublish_shifts. When I Work: POST /2/shifts/publish.

tools.name: wheniwork_unpublish_shifts
tools.description: Return published shifts to draft, hiding them from employees. Undo with wheniwork_publish_shifts. When I Work: POST /2/shifts/unpublish.

tools.name: wheniwork_create_time_off_request
tools.description: Create a time-off request for a user (default the calling user). It starts pending; cancel it with wheniwork_update_time_off_request (status 1). Get type ids from wheniwork_list_time_off_types. When I Work: POST /2/requests.

tools.name: wheniwork_update_time_off_request
tools.description: Change a time-off request: set its status (0 pending, 1 canceled, 2 accepted/approved, 3 expired, 4 denied) and/or its dates or hours. Reversible — set the status back. start_time and end_time must be given together. When I Work: PUT /2/requests/{request_id}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "wheniwork_get_account" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wheniwork_list_users, wheniwork_get_user, wheniwork_get_time_off_request, wheniwork_create_shift, wheniwork_create_time_off_request · Private data: wheniwork_get_account, wheniwork_update_shift · Public sink: wheniwork_list_users, wheniwork_get_user, wheniwork_get_shift, wheniwork_create_shift, wheniwork_publish_shifts, wheniwork_unpublish_shifts, wheniwork_create_time_off_request · Destructive: wheniwork_list_shift_swaps.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wheniwork_list_users, wheniwork_get_user, wheniwork_get_time_off_request, wheniwork_create_shift, wheniwork_create_time_off_request · Private data: wheniwork_get_account, wheniwork_update_shift · Public sink: wheniwork_list_users, wheniwork_get_user, wheniwork_get_shift, wheniwork_create_shift, wheniwork_publish_shifts, wheniwork_unpublish_shifts, wheniwork_create_time_off_request · Destructive: wheniwork_list_shift_swaps

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
